claim_evidence.beat: Chism recalled Perry visiting the set on "Moby Dick Day" and simply watching, wanting to "see what happens."
claim_evidence.supporting_passage: He showed up on set on something called Moby Dick Day in the movie. And I had so much to do that day. It was all the cast, it was a big day, it was a big production. And he was talking to me, and I was just like, 'What?!' You know, like there was no deference or respect. I'm like, 'Listen, sit down. I'll talk to you in a minute.' But it was fun to see him sit on the side and watch. And I thought, OK, I can't be Tyler Perry. I can only be myself. And luckily he did not want me to be Tyler Perry. He wanted me to be Tina, and he just stood back, and he's like, 'I wanna see what happens.'

claim_evidence.beat: She conceived the idea for the film while on vacation in Martha’s Vineyard and Sag Harbor.
claim_evidence.supporting_passage: I was on vacation and I came up with the idea when I was in Martha’s Vineyard. I was also in Sag Harbor during the same summer and both locations were brewing in my head.

claim_evidence.beat: The inspiration for the story came from reflecting on a past breakup and family secrets.
claim_evidence.supporting_passage: I had actually just came out of a breakup and I was doing an autopsy on the relationship. claim_evidence.beat: The entire script was completed in a remarkably fast three months.
